en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_PREFILLSTART: When a run starts mid-chart (checkpoint or editor play), the bar starts already filled up to that point instead of starting empty.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_USEMAPTIME: Advance the bar by the chart's elapsed time instead of tiles completed. The fill moves continuously every frame instead of stepping forward on each tile.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_FILLGRADIENT: Shift the fill colour as the run progresses (0% to 100%) instead of using one flat colour.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_STYLE: Modern is a floating rounded bar. Line is a thin strip stretched edge to edge along the top or bottom of the screen.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_LINEEDGE: Which screen edge the line is pinned to. It always spans the full width, flush against that edge.
